text: トキワ　ジムは　ずっと　へいさ　していたが　リーダーが　かえってきて　きょうから　ふっかつだ！

structure.jp: ずっと　へいさ　していたが
structure.en: was closed for a long time, but

structure.jp: リーダーが　かえってきて
structure.en: the Leader has come back, and

structure.jp: きょうから　ふっかつだ！
structure.en: from today it's back in business!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: いる after the て-form of a verb says a state goes on; with いた it went on in the past. へいさ　していた = 'had been closed'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after the て-form of a verb shows the action moving toward where the speaker is. かえってきて = 'has come back, and'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part joins it to the next one with the meaning 'but'. へいさ　していたが = 'it had been closed, but'.
